delhi_token.daily_cap_note: As reported for the May 2026 edition, Delhi Traffic Police released around 50,000 challans per day for download on the token portal across the four booking days; DSLSA announces the exact caps afresh per edition.
delhi_token.limits_note: As reported for the May 2026 edition, the token window opened on 4 May at 10:00 AM and ran to 7 May — five days before the 9 May sitting; DSLSA announces the exact windows, per-vehicle limits and eligibility cutoffs afresh for each edition.

delhi_extras.digital_lok_adalat_note: DSLSA organised a special Lok Adalat exclusively for traffic challans across all Delhi district court complexes on 14 February 2026 and launched a Digital Lok Adalat application for settling traffic matters.
delhi_extras.weekend_courts_note: As reported in July 2026, weekend traffic courts run from 5 July 2026 at all Delhi district court complexes — second Saturday and every Sunday, 10 am to 4 pm — for compoundable challans only; evening courts sit 5 pm to 7 pm on working days. Challan slips are downloaded from the Delhi Traffic Police portal, choosing a court complex and slot.
